source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the GA-style pedals seen from the pilot's seat (pedal faces with the PFC logo toward the viewer, heel plates below)
mappingSource: catalog (flypfc.com 2019_Cirrus_PFC_Pedals_USB_PFCUSB-MODE.pdf): yaw axis plus left and right toe brakes; the parts are named by function, no input numbers (the guide contradicts itself on the brake axis names, see identify.note).
